summary: Iteration 22: tested Investigation Toolkit (intel/alert-iocs/sandbox report backend + in-alert toolkit in Challenges & Labs + Tools page), Graded (required) lesson quizzes (backend + student UI + builder toggle) and 'Quiz all lessons' bulk AI generation (plan counts, generate, edit, required toggle, attach, regenerate, skip, save). New backend suite 23/23 pass; iteration-21 regression suite 22/22 pass. All requested UI flows work end-to-end with no page errors. Only minor issues found (data consistency in VT-style vendor table, cosmetic copy).

minor.issue: Vendor table flagged-row count can exceed the headline detection count, e.g. 185.220.101.45 shows 12/90 but 15/16 vendor rows flagged; paypa1-invoices.com 11/90 vs 13 flagged. Root cause toolkit.vendor_table: flagged=randint(9,15) is independent of `detected` (randint(8,18) or overridden by INTEL base detections). Fix: flagged = min(flagged, detected) computed after the base override.
related[] entries are labelled 'seen in the same incident' even when pulled from up to 3 different alerts (cs[:3]); relation label inaccurate for cross-incident pivots.

Process tree for lab files can include raw log lines as 'processes' (lab-linux-cron upload.php shows 'Jun 16 01:12:02 web-lnx-03 CRON[2201]: (root) CMD (...) (pid 2870)'). CMD_HINT extraction should skip syslog-formatted lines.

Context/IOC index cached 600s in-process: newly created/edited challenges or labs won't show IOCs/files in the toolkit (alert-iocs 404 for new ids) for up to 10 minutes. Invalidate cache on challenge/lab create/update.

ui_bugs.issue: When quiz is marked required, status still reads '5-question practice quiz attached' (line 54 ignores l.quiz.required).

issues: Pluralization: '1 lessons will get...', '1 lessons already have a quiz', 'Generate 1 quizzes', 'All done — 1 quizzes attached'

action_items: toolkit.vendor_table: cap flagged vendor rows to the final detection count (after INTEL base override) so 'N/90' and vendor list agree
LessonQuizBuilder: show 'required quiz attached' in lesson-quiz-status when quiz.required
Optional: fix pluralization in BulkQuiz copy; skip syslog lines in sandbox process tree; invalidate toolkit cache on challenge/lab edits; refine 'related' relation label
critical_code_review_comments: routes_learn.get_path strips answers for required quizzes for ALL roles (fine since builder loads via /manage/paths which keeps answers - verified).
pass_count uses ceil(n*3/5); a required quiz with 0 questions would pass with 0 answers - ensure manage validation rejects required quiz with empty questions.
Practice (non-required) quizzes still ship answers to the client by design (local grading) - acceptable since no XP.
BulkQuiz regenerate has no busy indicator on the review pane itself; the item just moves to 'generating' state (works).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor cosmetic issues only)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ paths (TEST_Graded Path via pytest, TEST_UI Graded / TEST_UI Bulk for UI) - all deleted. Student account gained +10 XP x2 from passing graded quizzes (pytest + UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mission briefing dialog did not appear for ch-phish-01 for the student (probably already dismissed); toolkit is visible directly in the sheet. Use ui_setup_iter22.py create/delete to make graded/bulk test paths. Bulk AI generation took ~20-40s per lesson and worked; 3 workers in parallel.
rca of the issue: Vendor/detection mismatch: vendor_table() draws flagged count from randint(9,15) for malicious regardless of detected value, and intel_report later overrides detected with INTEL base detections (e.g. 12) without re-capping vendor rows.
